messages.subject: Reminder: time entries outstanding for July
messages.plaintextBody:
Hi Tom,

Our records show unposted time for the week commencing 21 July. Please post all outstanding entries by close of business Wednesday so we can run the July client bills. If any of this relates to matters that should be written off, let me know.

Thanks,
Accounts
Whitfield Carter LLP
